article_content: A renowned lawyer, Caroline Pratte, has initiated a legal action against the safari firm and her guide, seeking over £300,000 in compensation. She sustained abdominal injuries and multiple fractures after being attacked by a wild elephant on a South Luangwa National Park, Zambia, safari. Her partner, Andrew Ness, who witnessed the terrifying event, too, is pursuing damages for psychological trauma. The couple, who maintain a charitable foundation, are holding the safari tour operator and the guide, Samuel Grace, accountable for the incident. The couple's allegations cite negligence on behalf of Lion Camp, but they have yet to assert the exact amount they deem equitable.

Soportió lesiones abdominales y múltiples fracturas al ser atacada por un elefante salvaje en un safari en el Parque Nacional de South Luangwa, Zambia. Su socio, Andrew Ness, quien presenció el evento espantoso, también está buscando indemnización por trastorno psicológico. La pareja, que también mantiene una donación benéfica, busca responsabilizar al operador de safaris y al guía, Samuel Grace, por el incidente.
